name: @dsh-plugins/memory-palace
description: DSH Memory Palace - Layered long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Episodic/semantic/procedural memory behind a four-tier visibility ACL; explainable SQL-pushdown cosine retrieval; time-decayed personalized PageRank; consensus synthesis; tombstoned right-to-be-forgotten; health observability; embedding failover; transactional two-phase ingest; TTL + retention lifecycle; access-refreshed decay; visibility-checked tools; SWR rank caches, Memory Capsules (inter-agent transport), reflection-based self-tuning, and an MCP stdio server; pseudo-relevance feedback, entity-hop recall expansion, as-of flashback queries, and a semantic query cache.
